**Diagnosis:** Fortinet-only CVEs are dropped in [detectCveByCpeURI](/app/detector/cve_client.go:144) because it retains only records with NVD data. Downstream, [detector.go](/app/detector/detector.go:330) enriches from NVD and JVN only; its CPE path adds only JVN advisories and its confidence function has no Fortinet signal.

A fix needs Fortinet conversion in [models/utils.go](/app/models/utils.go:8), a source type in [models/cvecontents.go](/app/models/cvecontents.go:294), and Fortinet ordering in [models/vulninfos.go](/app/models/vulninfos.go:391). `PrimarySrcURLs` in `models/cvecontents.go` also needs to select Fortinet links for reports. Both the scan path and [HTTP handler](/app/server/server.go:79) call the current NVD/JVN enrichment function. [go.mod](/app/go.mod:47) pins `go-cve-dictionary` v0.8.4; compatibility with the required Fortinet models and detection enums remains unverified.

The existing focused NVD/JVN confidence and content type tests pass offline, but they do not cover Fortinet. **No project source or tests were changed:** this specialist role was explicitly limited to fault localization. The required progress note is in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

Implemented Fortinet CVE detection and enrichment. Fortinet-only CVEs now pass CPE filtering, Fortinet detection methods contribute to confidence, and advisories populate CVE contents and advisory IDs. Reports can show Fortinet titles, summaries, CVSS v3 data, references, CWE IDs, dates, and advisory links. The scan and HTTP paths both use the new enrichment function.

Updated `go-cve-dictionary` to a Fortinet-capable version and added focused tests. Offline tests passed: `go test ./detector ./models ./server`.
